lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, circular pixel clusters are organized into semi-regular horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region. A specific group of four large, high-luminance spots forms a trapezoidal arrangement in the upper-mid quadrant of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes on the upper flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal side and shadow-induced lower values on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast silhouettes representing commensal organisms (remoras) located ventrally and posteriorly relative to the pectoral fin.
